meta.name: Signature Style
meta.edition: Harmonized — 100% official Catppuccin, per-theme (Mocha dark default / OLED true-black / Daylight high-contrast; Latte light legacy)

sigThemes.contract: MULTI-THEME SURFACE ENGINE (3.2.0): the canonical theme mechanism is the data-sig-theme attribute on <html> — absent or "mocha" = the :root default; "oled" = true-black; "daylight" = high-contrast light. The legacy [data-theme="latte"] light toggle (themes.latte) stays working untouched for backward compatibility but is OUTSIDE the canonical triad. Each theme declares only its overrides; everything else inherits :root. Per-theme WCAG tables: playground/verify-contrast.mjs (gates ct5/ct6; ct7 cross-checks this manifest against the css).

oled.description: True-black surface theme — the owner's --bg-canvas slot: pure #000000 base (the --bg-canvas alias resolves here), #0B0C10 cards, #12141C wells. Text keeps the #CDD6F4 family (13.52:1 on surface / 14.52:1 on black); hairlines keep the inherited 15-20% muted color-mix formulas; ALL --sig-* values INHERIT — chromatic ratios only increase on the darker surfaces (worst fill: crimson 4.68:1 on surface / 5.03:1 on black, floor 3.1; worst ink-floor: mauve-bright 5.00:1, floor 3.0).

daylight.description: High-contrast light theme: slate structure (#F8FAFC base, #FFFFFF cards, #F1F5F9 light wells — the dark-well concept inverts), dark slate ink rungs, cakes kept as light fills carrying dark ink (--color-on-cake #1E1E2E: 11.24:1 on #F2CDCD / 10.74:1 on #F5C2E7 / 11.01:1 on #94E2D5). The chromatic family re-inks below.

inkVariants.contract: The daylight re-ink of the chromatic family. Ratios are WCAG 2.x contrast vs #FFFFFF — the strictest daylight surface (#F8FAFC/#F1F5F9 are slightly darker, and mid-luminance inks note the inset margin). Floor: 3.1:1 for the 16 canonical chromatic tokens; 3.0:1 for the legacy ink-floor rung. 'inherits': the mocha value already clears the bar on white — no css declaration. tokens.css's [data-sig-theme="daylight"] block mirrors every override here (gate ct7).

--sig-yellow.note: amber-900 family per the release spec — the meter's Fair stage (1.27:1 on white) is unreadable on daylight

geometryPresets.contract: GEOMETRY PRESETS (3.2.0): the radius axis rides the data-sig-radius attribute on <html> — absent = the :root defaults (6px/12px, the byte-stable legacy look); "standard" = 8px/12px (8px-grid-pure — 6px never snapped to the grid); "sharp" = 0px/0px (brutalist). Presets compose with any surface theme (orthogonal axes). Mirrors the [data-sig-radius] blocks in css/tokens.css (gate rad2).

motionTokens.contract: KINETIC MOTION TOKENS (3.7.0 The Intelligent Kinetic Engine): the four spring curves are NATIVE CSS linear() easing functions (zero external animation dependencies) sampled stop-by-stop — the damped overshoot (>1.0 values) and settle are exact. linear() support: Chrome 113+ / Safari 17.2 / Firefox 112+; css/tokens.css carries a @supports not (transition-timing-function: linear(0, 1)) block re-declaring the four as cubic-bezier approximations (snappy 0.34,1.56,0.64,1 · gentle 0.25,1.25,0.45,1 · kinetic-out 0.16,1,0.3,1 · glide 0.4,0,0.2,1). The durations derive from ONE master dial, --sig-motion-scale (calc(scale × Nms)) — set it to 0.25 for slow-motion. REDUCED-MOTION MERCY: under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) AND the [data-sig-motion="reduced"] root override, all four durations collapse to 1ms (transitions effectively instant). Mirrors the :root Motion section + the fallback/mercy blocks in css/tokens.css (gate mo1); the 9 names ride the ThemeProvider whitelist (51 → 60, gate d).

--ease-spring-snappy.name: --ease-spring-snappy
--ease-spring-snappy.description: Damped fast spring — tactile detents: buttons, toggles, radio cards, the StatRing arc. Overshoots to 1.09 then settles within 70% of the duration.

--ease-spring-gentle.name: --ease-spring-gentle
--ease-spring-gentle.description: Smooth harmonic spring — larger surfaces and number rolls: AnimatedNumber, MotionReveal. One gentle overshoot to 1.06, a soft landing.

--ease-kinetic-out.name: --ease-kinetic-out
--ease-kinetic-out.description: High-velocity deceleration — data entrances: the AreaChart/Sparkline stroke sweeps leave the gate at 61% progress by 11% of the duration.

--ease-glide.name: --ease-glide
--ease-glide.description: Sliding glide — positional transitions: the FLIP tab/nav indicator, the directional carousel page. Barely-there overshoot (1.02), frictionless stop.

--dur-spring-snappy.name: --dur-spring-snappy
--dur-spring-snappy.description: Duration for the snappy spring — detents and ring arcs. Scales with --sig-motion-scale.

--dur-spring-gentle.name: --dur-spring-gentle
--dur-spring-gentle.description: Duration for the gentle spring — reveals and number rolls. Scales with --sig-motion-scale.

--dur-kinetic-out.name: --dur-kinetic-out
--dur-kinetic-out.description: Duration for the kinetic-out sweep — chart line entrances. Scales with --sig-motion-scale.

--dur-glide.name: --dur-glide
--dur-glide.description: Duration for the glide — FLIP indicators and carousel pages. Scales with --sig-motion-scale.

--sig-motion-scale.name: --sig-motion-scale
--sig-motion-scale.description: The time-dilation master dial. 1 = real time; 0.25 = slow-motion (the Motion Lab's Slow-Mo — springs visibly overshoot). Every kinetic duration is calc(scale × Nms), so one custom property dilates the whole engine.

sigPalette.description: The Chromatic Palette (0.4.0; 3.0.0 THE 16-COLOR CHROMATIC EXPANSION) — theme-independent CONTENT colors, defined once in :root and inherited by both Mocha and Latte untouched. 26 tokens: the 10 legacy + cobalt (blue retired, value carried) + the 15 chromatic fills.
sigPalette.ruleOfEngagement: RULE OF ENGAGEMENT: --sig-* tokens are reserved EXCLUSIVELY for content — badges, tags, avatars, event theme overrides, calendar blocks, data visualization. The Engine continues using Flamingo/Teal (--color-cake-primary / --color-cake-secondary) for ALL structural UI actions — buttons, inputs, focus rings. Never use --sig-* for structural chrome; never use Flamingo/Teal for content categories.

contrastPolicy.bodyText: ≥ 4.5:1 WCAG AA — tokens declared "ink" contrastTier carry body-size copy (< 1.5rem / 600) ONLY. 3.6.0 policy; every ink-tier token measures ≥4.5:1 vs its theme surface (mocha/oled/daylight) — measured, not tuned.
contrastPolicy.displayAndFills: ≥ 3.0:1 — tokens declared "display" contrastTier (and the chromatic fill/series family): use at ≥1.5rem/600 (large headings), as borders, fills, series strokes, badges and caption metadata — never body text at body-size emphasis. The sub-4.5 frozen inks (--sig-mauve-bright 3.22:1, --sig-lavender 3.95:1, --sig-peach 4.22:1, --text-muted 3.40:1 on mocha surface) are classified display tier by this policy — VALUES stay frozen (the v0.3.0 structural freeze); the policy documents the tier, enforced by verify:contrast (ct8) and adjudicated at runtime by verify:a11y (a11y4).

doctrine.token_cascade: One token in, four states out. Hover lightens (color-mix … 85%, white), active darkens (… 85%, black) and presses (scale 0.97), disabled grays out (--bg-surface + --text-muted), focus rings 2px solid --color-cake-primary. You never write a state hex code.
doctrine.override_protocol: Overrides are the Golden Weapon: scoped utility classes (.override-*) that alter ONE component locally. They define their own full state set and never touch :root. Danger keeps the owner's bright red #FF6B6B; gold keeps #FFD700→#DAA520.
doctrine.grid_8px: The 8px grid: --space-tight (0.5rem) / --space-standard (1rem) / --space-section (1.5rem) for all padding and gaps. Maximize negative space. Borders are 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-muted) 20%, transparent). Radius defaults to 6px in :root; the data-sig-radius presets retune it (standard 8px/12px — 8px-grid-pure; sharp 0px/0px). Zero drop shadows anywhere.
doctrine.themes: MULTI-THEME SURFACE ENGINE (3.2.0): the canonical surface themes ride the data-sig-theme attribute on <html> — absent or "mocha" = the :root default, "oled" = true-black (#000000 base / #0B0C10 surface / #12141C inset; every other token inherited), "daylight" = high-contrast light (#F8FAFC / #FFFFFF / #F1F5F9, dark slate ink, computed --sig-* ink variants ≥3.1:1 vs #FFFFFF). The legacy [data-theme="latte"] light toggle stays working, outside the triad. Default is Catppuccin Mocha (dark). The white version is Catppuccin Latte: opt in with <html data-theme="latte">. Keeper tokens carry legacy palette colors across editions with semantic jobs. HARMONIZED DOCTRINE (0.3.0): 100% official Catppuccin, per-theme — the dark toggle wears Mocha Flamingo (#F2CDCD) / Mocha Teal (#94E2D5), the light toggle wears Latte Flamingo (#DD7878) / Latte Teal (#179299). No cross-theme imports; harmony by construction.
doctrine.pillars: Four structural pillars (0.3.0): (1) Iconography — Lucide-React exclusively, 2px stroke matching Inter weight 500, never mix icon libraries; (2) Breakpoints — strict mobile shift at max-width: 768px, all multi-column grids collapse to a single column; (3) Z-Index Scale — sticky/toolbars z-10 (--z-sticky), dimming overlays/backdrops z-40 (--z-overlay), modals/popups/dropdowns z-50 (--z-modal); (4) Edge States — loading is a pulsing-opacity skeleton on --bg-surface, empty is a --bg-surface card with a Lucide icon and --text-muted text, centered.
